model.provider: Claude Code command line (claude -p) with the Claude Pro subscription login; no API key, no Extra Usage, no other provider, no fallback model
model.id_note: the model reported by the ping (alias sonnet resolved on 2026-10-18); passed to --model as the full id; every call must report this id in its init event and assistant messages, otherwise the search pauses

counting_policy.note: max_calls is a hard limit that retries and failed calls share; a usage-limit, overage or login pause is not a call and is not counted; an unparsable reply is a call with zero proposals; every valid, unique proposal is evaluated (max_evaluations = max_proposals)

fitness.definition: held-out gain RMSE(baseline) - RMSE(baseline + factor), subject-equal over held-out subjects with at least min_held_windows windows; higher is better
fitness.protocol_A: one split: first 75% of each subject's training period fits, the rest is held out, windows crossing the cut are in neither
fitness.protocol_B: deterministic 3-fold GroupKFold over the 27 training subjects
fitness.residuals: per split: baseline fitted on the training part only; training residual out-of-fold inside the training part, held-out residual from the baseline fitted on the whole training part

random_dsl.structure: 1/3 a single operator, 2/3 the product or ratio of two different operators; same grammar, grids, validator and duplicate rule as the model's proposals
random_dsl.budget_rule: stop after as many fitness evaluations of unique valid expressions as the model search made; total proposals, valid and invalid counts of both are reported

selection.pool_rule: first 25 expressions by training-split fitness (ties by first appearance), then the Spearman filter (|rho| > 0.9 against the 24 base lags and kept expressions), validation forward selection (k_max = 10, alpha logspace(-3, 3, 13), subject-equal RMSE), paired 1-SE, 20-window rule in Protocol A
selection.reference: same procedure as T_k (analysis) and O_k (analysis)
